metadata.name: beta_factory
metadata.description: BETA v2 factory (docs/DESIGN_V2.md §6): one fungible BETA on Solana backed by SOL held here and ETH held in BetaVault.sol on Ethereum. Cross-chain claims travel as Bitcoin transactions on each registered party's statement chain; this program judges the claims that are about Solana facts (burns, pending locks), acts provisionally on the ones about Ethereum (mints, rate-limited and vetoable), and slashes bonds it holds. Reads ipow's header relay read-only, like ipow-conversion.

docs: BETA v2 factory — `docs/DESIGN_V2.md` §6. One fungible BETA on Solana,
its SOL half held here, its ETH half held by `BetaVault.sol`. Cross-chain
claims are Bitcoin transactions on each party's statement chain; this
program judges claims about Solana facts, acts provisionally on claims
about Ethereum facts, and slashes the bonds it holds.

accounts.name: prior_party
docs: Required only to cancel a queued slot whose queuing party is dead.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The SOL reserve: pending locks and the backing of outstanding BETA.

accounts.name: bond_escrow
docs: Party bonds (operators and auditors), exact per-party accounting in `Party.bond`.

accounts.name: insurance
docs: Slashed bonds not owed to a specific victim accumulate here.

accounts.name: reward_pool
docs: Governance-funded pool that pays veto rewards (`fund_rewards`).

accounts.name: pending
docs: MINT: the pending lock named by the statement (address re-derived in the handler).

accounts.name: burn
docs: RELEASE: the burn named by the statement (address re-derived in the handler).

accounts.name: target_party
docs: VETO: the operator being vetoed.

accounts.name: target_anchor
docs: VETO: the vetoed anchor (absent for a dead-veto).

accounts.name: prior_party
docs: MINT re-anchor: the retired party that previously queued this pending slot.

accounts.name: attester
docs: The attesting party (required when an escrow is outstanding).

accounts.name: pending
docs: The pending slot (required when cancelling a never-exercised mint).

types.name: Burn
docs: A redemption: BETA burned, SOL paid, ETH half awaiting the operator's
RELEASE anchor. `claimed` is set when a RELEASE naming this burn is
judged true here; a second RELEASE for it is a lie.

fields.name: window_start_height
docs: Rate window: Bitcoin height the current window started at (from the
header relay's tip when the first mint of the window executed) and
units minted in it.

fields.name: eth_claims_units
docs: Whole-BETA units currently outstanding — equals the ETH claims the
Ethereum vault must honor.

fields.name: reserve_lamports
docs: Lamports in the vault backing outstanding BETA (excludes pending locks).

fields.name: pending_lamports
docs: Lamports in the vault held for not-yet-minted pending locks.

types.name: FactoryParams
docs: Governance-settable parameters. Governance sets numbers; it never
judges whether a statement was true (DESIGN_V2 §6.7).

fields.name: sol_per_unit
docs: Composition: lamports of SOL backing one whole BETA.

fields.name: eth_gwei_per_unit
docs: Composition: gwei of ETH backing one whole BETA (checked on Ethereum).

fields.name: window_blocks
docs: v2 rate window — kept for layout compatibility; unused in v3
(exposure is per-action escrow, DESIGN_V2 §7.5).

fields.name: t_skip_secs
docs: A stalled anchor (preimage never revealed) may be skipped once the
header carrying it is this old.

fields.name: t_challenge_secs
docs: v3 challenge window: a queued MINT executes early only on an
ATTEST, otherwise after this long if no VETO stands; escrows settle
at its end (DESIGN_V2 §7). (Field position inherited from v2's
`t_pause_secs`.)

fields.name: comp_lamports_per_unit
docs: Slash per unit for a false statement about Solana; paid to the
named user (false MINT) or to insurance (false RELEASE).

fields.name: veto_slash_lamports
docs: Slash for an auditor whose veto of a RELEASE was wrong; reward for
one that was right (paid from insurance when funded).

fields.name: bounty_bps
docs: Share of any slash paid to whoever submitted the anchor.

types.name: Party
docs: A registered statement-maker. `party_id` is the cross-chain identity
(the same 32 bytes are registered on Ethereum); `anchor_txid_le`/
`anchor_vout` is the head of its statement chain as this chain has
processed it (DESIGN_V2 §6.2).

fields.name: seq
docs: Number of anchors processed on this chain.

fields.name: bond
docs: Lamports of this party's bond held in `bond_escrow`.

fields.name: dead
docs: Set by a slash for a false statement about Solana. A dead party's
anchors are still processed (so further lies can be judged) but
never exercised.

fields.name: paused_until
docs: Operator only: set by an auditor's dead-veto; mints are not
exercised until it lapses.

types.name: Pending
docs: User X's SOL half of a mint, locked in the vault, waiting for the
operator's MINT anchor. `approved`/`eth_lock_id` is the user's on-chain
consent (DESIGN_V2 §6.3's `sig_X`, done as a signed instruction instead
of an ed25519 signature inside the statement).

fields.name: queued
docs: A MINT anchor referencing this lock has been processed and queued;
the lock can no longer expire — it will be minted when capacity
allows (§6.7).

fields.name: queued_by
docs: Party whose MINT anchor queued this lock. If that party is later
retired (`dead`), a live operator may re-anchor the same MINT and
take the slot over, or the user may cancel after the deadline
(DESIGN_V2 §6.12, "stranded queued mint").

types.name: ProcessedAnchor
docs: One processed anchor, keyed by its Bitcoin txid. Exists forever so an
anchor can never be processed twice and so vetoes/audits can refer to
it.

fields.name: challenge_until
docs: v3: end of the challenge window (`processed_at + t_challenge_secs`).

fields.name: held
docs: v3: a VETO stands against this anchor (lifted only by a CLEAR).

fields.name: attested_by
docs: v3: party whose ATTEST covers this anchor (zero = none) and the
escrow it reserved for it; `settled` once the window was settled.
